description: Get an AI summary of any Instagram Reel — a short paragraph plus key points, without watching the video. Costs 4 credits. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh. Envelope includes cached + cachedAt on hits.

language.description: ISO code, e.g. "tr": pins the speech language and sets the summary output language. Defaults to auto-detect + English summary.

url.description: Instagram Reel URL, e.g. https://instagram.com/reel/ID/. The URL platform must match this endpoint's platform. Do not pass cross-platform URLs, e.g. YouTube to TikTok, Instagram to Facebook, LinkedIn to X/Twitter, or Pinterest to Rumble.

name: instagram_summarize
title: Instagram Summarizer
